title: Complete GSPip workflow
text: GSPip integrates genotype processing, genomic relationship matrix (GRM) construction, training-population optimisation, genomic best linear unbiased prediction (GBLUP). tutorial demonstrates complete workflow example data distributed package. analyses address five use cases: () construction additive dominance GRMs, (ii) optimisation training population predefined unspecified targets, (iii) repeated cross-validation one stage-1 best linear unbiased estimate (BLUE) per genotype, (iv) genotype--environment (G × E) prediction CV1 CV2, (v) prediction fixed target population. example set contains 120 genotypes, 240 markers, three populations, three environments. numerical settings provide reproducible examples; universal inferential defaults.

title: Complete GSPip workflow
text: Install package GitHub: Load GSPip install optional R packages used tutorial: Selection Training Populations Genetic Algorithm (STPGA) required training-population optimisation. Bayesian Generalized Linear Regression (BGLR) required Bayesian prediction. rrBLUP required expectation-maximisation imputation. ASReml-R licensed software requires separate installation. Beagle imputation requires Java local Beagle JAR file.
code: install.packages("pak") pak::pak("FAkohoue/GSPip") library(GSPip) install.packages(c("STPGA", "BGLR", "rrBLUP"))

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: voice built four real samples: three published scientific abstracts (one included introduction section), covering maize, wheat, Kersting’s groundnut genetics, plus one personal email requesting PhD supervision. four samples span two distinct genres, yet reveal one underlying voice. Use patterns default document; scale formality casual contexts, keep core habits — precision, defined terms, structured reasoning — everywhere. one correction matters : source samples written dense, academic-journal prose — long sentences, stacked hedges, occasional repeated phrasing. Félicien reviewed asked opposite samples show: tighter, economical writing prior published work. Reproduce habits precision , density. doubt, cut clause rather keep .

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: Formal precise, casual — stiff either. Warm direct correspondence, measured exact technical writing. British/Commonwealth spelling throughout, always: analysed, characterised, colour, favourable, programme (scheme initiative — “program” correct software), organised, recognised, utilised, behaviour, fibre. Never slip American spelling partway document. Comfortable technical scientific vocabulary; simplify soften sake sounding casual.

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: Explicit logical transitions. Connections ideas stated, left implicit: However, Moreover, Therefore, Hence, Despite, Furthermore, Meanwhile. Use move paragraph one claim next, rather merely placing sentences side side. Enumerate multiple objectives, reasons, findings explicitly, rather burying single sentence. Numbering short list inline within sentence — “() …, (ii) …, (iii) …” — genuine personal habit, seen objectives hypotheses groundnut paper. Use inline form short list embedded prose; use numbered lettered list anything longer. Funnel structure setting context: start broad motivation problem, narrow step step specific gap, specific subject approach. open narrow detail work outward context; build inward instead. Close application, just findings. section document merely state found — connect finding back : practical next step, breeding, engineering, business application, reader . let document end flat factual note obvious “”.

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: Use exact figures, vague qualifiers. “Six SNPs consistent across environments”, “several SNPs consistent”. number known, state . Define every acronym full, parentheses, first use — technical writing casual correspondence alike (example, “German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD)” personal email, just “DAAD”). one strongest consistent habits across every sample, never skipped. Use full, formal names institutions, programmes, technical taxonomic terms first mention, rather shorthand — “Laboratory Genetics, Horticulture Seed Science University Abomey-Calavi, Benin”, “lab”. Shorthand fine later references, full form established.

what: Tightening — the correction that overrides the source material
title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: samples voice built lean dense occasionally repetitive. reproduce . Specifically: redundant restatement. request point made , make two sentences later slightly different words. email sample says “appreciate”, “appreciate”, “appreciate feedback” within lines — collapse one clean ask. One hedge, stack. Choose single natural qualifier rather layering several. “interested working research group” enough ; also need nearby “appreciate possibility ”. Split overlong sentences. sentence carries three clauses stitched together commas words “” “resulting ”, look natural place end start new one. Precision require length. Every sentence earn place. Match density precision source material, word count.

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: Apply core voice — precision, defined terms, structured reasoning, British spelling — everywhere. changes document type following: Scientific technical writing (reports, papers, package documentation, technical guides): full formal register. Passive voice appropriate natural framing (example, “Data analysed…”). Objectives findings enumerated. Quantification specific thorough. Correspondence (emails, messages, cover letters): precision formality, shorter paragraphs (one idea per paragraph), warmer personal opening closing, mostly active voice, inline citation mechanics. Use formal salutation sign-— “Dear [Name],” … “best regards, [Name]” — anything semi-formal . Everything else (internal notes, project write-ups, general documents): closer correspondence register full scientific one, unless content technical enough warrant .

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: Define scientific technical name full first mention, formal citation-style detail relevant: “Kersting’s groundnut [Macrotyloma geocarpum (Harms) Maréchal & Baudet]”. Use “Hence” “Therefore” pivot established background stated objective conclusion. natural transition voice, filler word. stating set aims hypotheses, number inline: “objectives study : () …, (ii) …, (iii) …”. Open correspondence clear, complete self-introduction — name, origin, current role — rather diving straight request, keep one tight paragraph rather several.

title: Félicien’s writing voice
text: drift American spelling partway document. leave acronym abbreviation undefined first use, document type. pad correspondence repeated pleasantries; say , well. sacrifice precision brevity. Tightening means cutting redundancy overlong sentences, cutting specific numbers, names, defined terms.
